q: Biology is broadly divided into five major themes: organization, information, energy and matter, interactions and evolution.
e: True. Biology is broadly divided into five major themes: organization, information, energy and matter, interactions and evolution.

q: The hierarchy of life on earth is unfolded as follows: biosphere, ecosystem, community, population, organism, organ system, organ, tissue, cell, organelle, molecule and atom.
e: True. The hierarchy of life on earth is unfolded as follows: biosphere, ecosystem, community, population, organism, organ system, organ, tissue, cell, organelle, molecule and atom.

q: With each set up, new properties emerge because of interactions among components at the higher levels.
e: False. With each set up, new properties emerge because of interactions among components at the lower levels. The stem used higher instead of lower.

q: The structure and function of biological components are interrelated.
e: True. The structure and function of biological components are interrelated.

q: The hummingbird's anatomy allows the wings to rotate at the shoulder, so hummingbirds have the ability, unique among birds, to fly backward or hover in place.
e: True. The hummingbird's anatomy allows the wings to rotate at the shoulder, so hummingbirds have the ability, unique among birds, to fly backward or hover in place.

q: The cell is the highest level of organization that can perform all activities required for life.
e: False. The cell is the lowest level of organization that can perform all activities required for life. The stem used highest instead of lowest.

q: Cells are either prokaryote or eukaryote.
e: True. Cells are either prokaryote or eukaryote.

q: Eukaryotic cells contain membrane-enclosed organelles, including DNA in nucleus whereas prokaryotic cells lack membrane-enclosed organelles.
e: True. Eukaryotic cells contain membrane-enclosed organelles, including DNA in nucleus while prokaryotic cells lack membrane-enclosed organelles.

q: Prokaryotic cells contain membrane-enclosed organelles, including DNA in a nucleus.
e: False. Prokaryotic cells lack membrane-enclosed organelles, including DNA in a nucleus. The stem used contain instead of lack.

q: The genetic information is encoded in the nucleotide sequences of DNA.
e: True. The genetic information is encoded in the nucleotide sequences of DNA.

q: The DNA transmits heritable information from parents to offspring.
e: True. The DNA transmits heritable information from parents to offspring.

q: DNA sequences (called genes) act as instructions to make a cell's protein production by being transcribed into specific proteins and then translated into mRNA.
e: False. DNA sequences (called genes) act as instructions to make a cell's protein production by being transcribed into mRNA and then translated into specific proteins.

q: The processes of transcription and translation to produce proteins are called gene expression.
e: True. The processes of transcription and translation to produce proteins are called gene expression.

q: Gene expression can also produce some RNAs that are not translated into proteins but serve other important functions.
e: True. Gene expression can also produce some RNAs that are not translated into proteins but serve other important functions.

q: Energy flows through the ecosystem.
e: True. Energy flows through the ecosystem.

q: All organisms require energy for their life.
e: True. All organisms require energy for their life.

q: Producers convert energy from sunlight to chemical energy and some of which is then passed to consumers.
e: True. Producers convert energy from sunlight to chemical energy and some of which is then passed to consumers.

q: The rest of the energy from producers is stored in the ecosystem as heat.
e: False. The rest of the energy from producers is lost from the ecosystem as heat. The stem used stored instead of lost.

q: Chemical cycle occurs between organisms and the environment.
e: True. Chemical cycle occurs between organisms and the environment.

q: Organisms interact continuously with physical factors.
e: True. Organisms interact continuously with physical factors.

q: In feedback regulation, a process is regulated by its input or reactant.
e: False. In feedback regulation, a process is regulated by its output or product. The stem used input instead of output.

q: In negative feedback, accumulation of the product slows its production.
e: True. In negative feedback, accumulation of the product slows its production.

q: In positive feedback, a product slows down its own production.
e: False. In positive feedback, a product speeds up its own production. The stem used slows instead of speeds.

q: Feedback is a type of regulation common to life at all levels, from molecules to ecosystems.
e: True. Feedback is a type of regulation common to life at all levels, from molecules to ecosystems.

q: Evolution is the process of change that has transformed life on Earth, accounts for the unity and diversity of life.
e: True. Evolution is the process of change that has transformed life on Earth, accounts for the unity and diversity of life.

q: Domain Bacteria and Archaea consist of eukaryotes.
e: False. Domain Bacteria and Archaea consist of prokaryotes. The stem used eukaryotes instead of prokaryotes.

q: Domain Eukarya includes various groups of protists as well as fungi, plants, and animals.
e: True. Domain Eukarya includes various groups of protists as well as fungi, plants, and animals.

q: Darwin proposed natural selection as the mechanism for evolutionary adaptation of populations to their environments.
e: True. Darwin proposed natural selection as the mechanism for evolutionary adaptation of populations to their environments.

q: Natural selection occurs when environmental factors consistently cause individuals with certain heritable traits to have lesser reproductive success.
e: False. Natural selection occurs when environmental factors consistently cause individuals with certain heritable traits to have greater reproductive success. The stem used lesser instead of greater.

q: The hummingbird's anatomy allows the wings to rotate at the elbow, so hummingbirds have the ability to fly backward.
e: False. The hummingbird's anatomy allows the wings to rotate at the shoulder, so hummingbirds have the ability to fly backward. The stem used elbow instead of shoulder.

q: The cell is a basic unit structure and function of an organism.
e: True. The cell is a basic unit structure and function of an organism.

q: Eukaryotic cells lack membrane-enclosed organelles.
e: False. Eukaryotic cells contain membrane-enclosed organelles. The stem used lack instead of contain.

q: DNA sequences are called chromosomes.
e: False. DNA sequences are called genes. The stem used chromosomes instead of genes.

q: Producers convert energy from chemical energy to sunlight.
e: False. Producers convert energy from sunlight to chemical energy and some of which is then passed to consumers.

q: Domain Eukarya consists of prokaryotes.
e: False. Domain Bacteria and Archaea consist of prokaryotes. The stem used eukarya instead of bacteria.
